content:
samira_csm: Heads-up: we had partial onboarding failures last night affecting embeddings and auth for several trials. Need an interim customer note and targeted outreach for renewals within 45 days.

leo_ops: Root cause: cache eviction tuned too aggressively during a write burst; some sessions lost auth state, causing 401s and retries that increased embedding latency. Rolled a rollback + short-term retry throttle. Monitoring looks stable.

incident_bot: Hotfix deployed by leo_ops at 2025-11-14T02:40Z. Canary checks green.

mina_support: Can CS get impacted tenant list and renewal windows? We'll segment high-touch vs standard.

samira_csm: Pulling list now. High-touch: MedBridge, QuantileAI, PaperTrail. Mid: StoreGrid, Formance. Low: TraceOps.

ravi_sales: For high-touch recommend exec note + 1-month credit + two priority onboarding seats. Need finance signoff.

jordan_finance: Pre-approve one-month credits for trials flagged as priority. Please include explicit credit wording in the message (next invoice or refund). Log under ticket CS-8121.

leo_ops: Technical blurb for customers: A cache compaction configuration interacted with a high ingestion burst causing premature token eviction and auth failures (401). We reverted the change, increased cache headroom, and added a retry throttle and an auth-failure alert. Full RCA and timeline forthcoming.

samira_csm: Draft interim message: "Hi <Customer>, we experienced transient auth errors and slower embedding responses on 2025-11-13 that may have affected onboarding. We've reverted the configuration change and applied a fix; monitoring is normal. We're offering a one-month credit (applied to your next invoice or refunded on request) or dedicated onboarding time. Full technical RCA within 48 hours. Your CSM will follow up to schedule priority support if needed." Thoughts?

mina_support: Add a line asking customers to share example request IDs/times to help log correlation.

samira_csm: Added. Plan: send interim note in 60 minutes, priority outreach to top 3, full RCA in 48 hours, office hours within 5 business days. Proceed? React :thumbsup:.

leo_ops: :thumbsup:

ravi_sales: :thumbsup:

incident_bot: Incident assigned P2. Next auto-update in 2 hours."
